verdict.rationale: AFK runs company-ops processes as directed graphs of steps, so versioning and dev-to-production promotion is a fair question for it. The evidence never mentions workflow versioning, source-control sync, separate environments, or promotion. The 'GitHubCode' item appears to be an integration listing, not workflow version control, and audit logs and RBAC are adjacent governance features rather than versioning.
